name: Grafana MCP server
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C8, C10; partly meets C5, C7; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The source repository is public and release v2.3.0 is published from it. The release assets include a Sigstore bundle for the checksums file (`mcp-grafana_2.3.0_checksums.txt.sigstore.json`) and SBOM files.

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository, and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release v2.3.0 is dated 2026-11-10; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Write tools are on unless `--disable-write` is set; several tool categories are off by default. Quoted: “The `--disable-write` flag provides a way to run the MCP server in read-only mode, preventing any write operations to your Grafana instance.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The service-account token is supplied through an environment variable. Quoted: “"GRAFANA_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN": "<your service account token>"”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: Anonymous usage statistics are documented as on by default, with documented ways to turn them off. Quoted: “**Reporting is enabled by default**. To opt out, set `--usage-stats=disabled`, `GRAFANA_USAGE_STATS=disabled`, or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`.”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`go.sum`) and an update configuration (`renovate.json`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: go-sdk v1.8.0 in go.mod. Lower-bound version v1.8.0 of github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk was published on 2026-09-04, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
